commentary: A good day for the pot, up £877. Wall Street bounced back as strong CoreWeave results and a raised revenue forecast revived confidence in AI: the S&P 500 rose 1.3% and the Nasdaq 1.6%. The global tracker VWRP added 1.7% (about £566), Alphabet rose 2.0% (about £208) and NVIDIA rebounded 2.9% (about £115) after falling 9.6% in two sessions. HSBC gained 1.1% (about £108) as the FTSE 100 rose 0.8% to 10,835.47, and Shell added 1.3% as Brent oil rose 2.4% to about $93.69 after Iran said it would not let enriched nuclear material leave the country. Microsoft fell 2.3% (about £71), Amazon 1.7% (about £56) and Meta 2.0% (about £36). The pound slipped to 1.3277 from 1.3341, which lifts the US holdings in sterling.
